tool.name: Biomni: Create Deformable Transform
tool.description: Create a deformable (B-spline) transform for image registration.
tool.help:
**Biomni: Create Deformable Transform**
Create a deformable (B-spline) transform for image registration.
Args: fixed_image: Reference (fixed) image moving_image: Image to be registered number_of_control_points: Number of B-spline control points per dimension
Returns: Deformable transform object
**Domain**: bioimaging **Function**: create_deformable_transform
